id = 'event_social_0_5'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )
            if kind in ("weapon", "armour", "household"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                made = next(
                    i
                    for i in result["state"]["items"]
                    if i.get("template") == id and i["owner"] == "hero" and i.get("made_by") == "hero"
                )
                if kind == "household":
                    result = run(
                        result["state"], next_context, "consume", {"item": made["id"], "target": "hero"}
                    )
                    assert any(e["kind"] == "equipment_used" for e in result["battle_events"])
                else:
                    result = run(result["state"], next_context, "equip", {"item": made["id"]})
                    ready = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                    engine = Engine(result["state"], ready, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                    if kind == "weapon":
                        if row["category"] in ("longbow", "crossbow"):
                            engine.add_item("use_ammunition_0_0")
                        engine.state["battle"] = {
                            "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                            "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                            "round": 1,
                        }
                        from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import hit
    
                        hit(engine, "hero", "watcher")
                        assert (
                            engine.attacks
                            and next(i for i in engine.state["items"] if i["id"] == made["id"])[
                                "durability"
                            ]
                            == made["durability"] - 1
                        )
                    else:
                        before = engine.world.hp
                        assert engine.defence("hero") >= 10
                        engine.damage("hero", 6, row["resistance"])
                        assert engine.world.hp >= before - 5
                    result = engine.finish()
        elif kind == "creature":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import npc_round
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import spawn_creature
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            actor_id = spawn_creature(engine, row, "unit-encounter")
            if row["behavior"] in ("healer", "scavenger", "skirmisher"):
                engine.change_hp(actor_id, 1 - engine.hp(actor_id))
            engine.state["battle"] = {
                "order": ["hero", actor_id],
                "sides": {"hero": "party", actor_id: "enemy"},
                "round": 1,
            }
            before_hp = engine.world.hp
            npc_round(engine, "recover")
            assert (
                engine.attacks or engine.events or engine.state["statuses"] or engine.hp(actor_id) > 1
            )
            result = engine.finish()
            assert any(a["id"] == actor_id for a in result["catalog"]["entities"])
            assert result["world"]["hp"] <= before_hp
        elif kind == "event":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import apply_event
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            for actor_id, resident in engine.state["living_world"]["residents"].items():
                resident["job"] = "resident"
                resident["knowledge"] = ["observed_" + actor_id]
            old = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert apply_event(engine, row)
            new = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert old != new

                )

                )

                    if kind == "recipe"

                )

                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})

                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )

                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )

id = 'event_social_0_8'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )

id = 'event_social_1_0'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )
            if kind in ("weapon", "armour", "household"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                made = next(
                    i
                    for i in result["state"]["items"]
                    if i.get("template") == id and i["owner"] == "hero" and i.get("made_by") == "hero"
                )
                if kind == "household":
                    result = run(
                        result["state"], next_context, "consume", {"item": made["id"], "target": "hero"}
                    )
                    assert any(e["kind"] == "equipment_used" for e in result["battle_events"])
                else:
                    result = run(result["state"], next_context, "equip", {"item": made["id"]})
                    ready = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                    engine = Engine(result["state"], ready, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                    if kind == "weapon":
                        if row["category"] in ("longbow", "crossbow"):
                            engine.add_item("use_ammunition_0_0")
                        engine.state["battle"] = {
                            "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                            "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                            "round": 1,
                        }
                        from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import hit
    
                        hit(engine, "hero", "watcher")
                        assert (
                            engine.attacks
                            and next(i for i in engine.state["items"] if i["id"] == made["id"])[
                                "durability"
                            ]
                            == made["durability"] - 1
                        )
                    else:
                        before = engine.world.hp
                        assert engine.defence("hero") >= 10
                        engine.damage("hero", 6, row["resistance"])
                        assert engine.world.hp >= before - 5
                    result = engine.finish()
        elif kind == "creature":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import npc_round
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import spawn_creature
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            actor_id = spawn_creature(engine, row, "unit-encounter")
            if row["behavior"] in ("healer", "scavenger", "skirmisher"):
                engine.change_hp(actor_id, 1 - engine.hp(actor_id))
            engine.state["battle"] = {
                "order": ["hero", actor_id],
                "sides": {"hero": "party", actor_id: "enemy"},
                "round": 1,
            }
            before_hp = engine.world.hp
            npc_round(engine, "recover")
            assert (
                engine.attacks or engine.events or engine.state["statuses"] or engine.hp(actor_id) > 1
            )
            result = engine.finish()
            assert any(a["id"] == actor_id for a in result["catalog"]["entities"])
            assert result["world"]["hp"] <= before_hp
        elif kind == "event":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import apply_event
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            for actor_id, resident in engine.state["living_world"]["residents"].items():
                resident["job"] = "resident"
                resident["knowledge"] = ["observed_" + actor_id]
            old = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert apply_event(engine, row)
            new = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert old != new

            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {

                    "target": "watcher"

                }

                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0

                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (

                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(

                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )

id = 'event_social_1_5'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )
            if kind in ("weapon", "armour", "household"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                made = next(
                    i
                    for i in result["state"]["items"]
                    if i.get("template") == id and i["owner"] == "hero" and i.get("made_by") == "hero"
                )
                if kind == "household":
                    result = run(
                        result["state"], next_context, "consume", {"item": made["id"], "target": "hero"}
                    )
                    assert any(e["kind"] == "equipment_used" for e in result["battle_events"])
                else:
                    result = run(result["state"], next_context, "equip", {"item": made["id"]})

id = 'event_social_1_7'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )
            if kind in ("weapon", "armour", "household"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                made = next(
                    i
                    for i in result["state"]["items"]
                    if i.get("template") == id and i["owner"] == "hero" and i.get("made_by") == "hero"
                )
                if kind == "household":
                    result = run(
                        result["state"], next_context, "consume", {"item": made["id"], "target": "hero"}
                    )
                    assert any(e["kind"] == "equipment_used" for e in result["battle_events"])
                else:
                    result = run(result["state"], next_context, "equip", {"item": made["id"]})
                    ready = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                    engine = Engine(result["state"], ready, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                    if kind == "weapon":
                        if row["category"] in ("longbow", "crossbow"):
                            engine.add_item("use_ammunition_0_0")
                        engine.state["battle"] = {
                            "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                            "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                            "round": 1,
                        }
                        from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import hit
    
                        hit(engine, "hero", "watcher")
                        assert (
                            engine.attacks
                            and next(i for i in engine.state["items"] if i["id"] == made["id"])[
                                "durability"
                            ]
                            == made["durability"] - 1
                        )
                    else:
                        before = engine.world.hp
                        assert engine.defence("hero") >= 10
                        engine.damage("hero", 6, row["resistance"])
                        assert engine.world.hp >= before - 5
                    result = engine.finish()
        elif kind == "creature":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import npc_round
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import spawn_creature
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            actor_id = spawn_creature(engine, row, "unit-encounter")
            if row["behavior"] in ("healer", "scavenger", "skirmisher"):
                engine.change_hp(actor_id, 1 - engine.hp(actor_id))
            engine.state["battle"] = {
                "order": ["hero", actor_id],
                "sides": {"hero": "party", actor_id: "enemy"},
                "round": 1,
            }
            before_hp = engine.world.hp
            npc_round(engine, "recover")
            assert (
                engine.attacks or engine.events or engine.state["statuses"] or engine.hp(actor_id) > 1
            )
            result = engine.finish()
            assert any(a["id"] == actor_id for a in result["catalog"]["entities"])
            assert result["world"]["hp"] <= before_hp
        elif kind == "event":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import apply_event
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            for actor_id, resident in engine.state["living_world"]["residents"].items():
                resident["job"] = "resident"
                resident["knowledge"] = ["observed_" + actor_id]
            old = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert apply_event(engine, row)
            new = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert old != new

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:

id = 'event_social_2_2'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )
            if kind in ("weapon", "armour", "household"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                made = next(
                    i
                    for i in result["state"]["items"]
                    if i.get("template") == id and i["owner"] == "hero" and i.get("made_by") == "hero"
                )
                if kind == "household":
                    result = run(
                        result["state"], next_context, "consume", {"item": made["id"], "target": "hero"}
                    )
                    assert any(e["kind"] == "equipment_used" for e in result["battle_events"])
                else:
                    result = run(result["state"], next_context, "equip", {"item": made["id"]})
                    ready = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                    engine = Engine(result["state"], ready, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                    if kind == "weapon":
                        if row["category"] in ("longbow", "crossbow"):
                            engine.add_item("use_ammunition_0_0")
                        engine.state["battle"] = {
                            "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                            "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                            "round": 1,
                        }
                        from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import hit
    
                        hit(engine, "hero", "watcher")
                        assert (
                            engine.attacks
                            and next(i for i in engine.state["items"] if i["id"] == made["id"])[
                                "durability"
                            ]
                            == made["durability"] - 1
                        )
                    else:
                        before = engine.world.hp
                        assert engine.defence("hero") >= 10
                        engine.damage("hero", 6, row["resistance"])
                        assert engine.world.hp >= before - 5
                    result = engine.finish()
        elif kind == "creature":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import npc_round
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import spawn_creature
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            actor_id = spawn_creature(engine, row, "unit-encounter")
            if row["behavior"] in ("healer", "scavenger", "skirmisher"):
                engine.change_hp(actor_id, 1 - engine.hp(actor_id))
            engine.state["battle"] = {
                "order": ["hero", actor_id],
                "sides": {"hero": "party", actor_id: "enemy"},
                "round": 1,
            }
            before_hp = engine.world.hp
            npc_round(engine, "recover")
            assert (
                engine.attacks or engine.events or engine.state["statuses"] or engine.hp(actor_id) > 1
            )
            result = engine.finish()
            assert any(a["id"] == actor_id for a in result["catalog"]["entities"])
            assert result["world"]["hp"] <= before_hp
        elif kind == "event":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import apply_event
    
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            for actor_id, resident in engine.state["living_world"]["residents"].items():
                resident["job"] = "resident"
                resident["knowledge"] = ["observed_" + actor_id]
            old = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert apply_event(engine, row)
            new = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert old != new

            )

                assert (

                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )

                )
            else:

id = 'event_social_2_7'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )
            if kind in ("weapon", "armour", "household"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                made = next(
                    i
                    for i in result["state"]["items"]
                    if i.get("template") == id and i["owner"] == "hero" and i.get("made_by") == "hero"
                )
                if kind == "household":
                    result = run(
                        result["state"], next_context, "consume", {"item": made["id"], "target": "hero"}
                    )
                    assert any(e["kind"] == "equipment_used" for e in result["battle_events"])
                else:
                    result = run(result["state"], next_context, "equip", {"item": made["id"]})

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }
                if primary == "revive":
                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            result = run(
                ready["state"],
                ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
            if kind == "material" and row["process"] == 0:
                result = run(state, ctx, "gather", {"material": id, "quantity": 1})
                assert (
                    result["state"]["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id]
                    == state["living_world"]["nodes"]["pier"][id] - 1
                )
            elif kind == "recipe" and row["category"] == "repair":
                engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                item = engine.add_item(f"gear_sword_{row['compatible_material']}_0")
                item["durability"] = 1
                ready = engine.finish()
                result = run(
                    ready["state"],
                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",
                    {"recipe": id, "item": item["id"]},
                )
                assert (
                    next(i for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])["durability"] > 1
                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )
            if kind in ("weapon", "armour", "household"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                made = next(
                    i
                    for i in result["state"]["items"]
                    if i.get("template") == id and i["owner"] == "hero" and i.get("made_by") == "hero"
                )
                if kind == "household":
                    result = run(
                        result["state"], next_context, "consume", {"item": made["id"], "target": "hero"}
                    )
                    assert any(e["kind"] == "equipment_used" for e in result["battle_events"])
                else:
                    result = run(result["state"], next_context, "equip", {"item": made["id"]})
                    ready = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                    engine = Engine(result["state"], ready, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
                    if kind == "weapon":
                        if row["category"] in ("longbow", "crossbow"):
                            engine.add_item("use_ammunition_0_0")
                        engine.state["battle"] = {
                            "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                            "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                            "round": 1,
                        }
                        from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import hit
    
                        hit(engine, "hero", "watcher")
                        assert (
                            engine.attacks
                            and next(i for i in engine.state["items"] if i["id"] == made["id"])[
                                "durability"
                            ]
                            == made["durability"] - 1
                        )
                    else:

                        assert engine.defence("hero") >= 10
                        engine.damage("hero", 6, row["resistance"])
                        assert engine.world.hp >= before - 5
                    result = engine.finish()
        elif kind == "creature":
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_actions_v2 import npc_round
            from rpg_vkr.domain.catalog_world import spawn_creature

            actor_id = spawn_creature(engine, row, "unit-encounter")

                engine.change_hp(actor_id, 1 - engine.hp(actor_id))
            engine.state["battle"] = {
                "order": ["hero", actor_id],

                "round": 1,

            for actor_id, resident in engine.state["living_world"]["residents"].items():

                resident["knowledge"] = ["observed_" + actor_id]
            old = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert apply_event(engine, row)
            new = json.dumps(
                {
                    "world": engine.state["living_world"],
                    "actors": [a.to_dict() for a in engine.actors.values()],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
            assert old != new

                item["durability"] = 1

                result = run(

                    ctx | {k: ready[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")},
                    "repair",

                )
            else:
                recipe = (
                    row
                    if kind == "recipe"
                    else next(r for r in catalog.available("recipe") if id in r["outputs"])
                )
                output = recipe["outputs"][0] if kind == "recipe" else id
                old = sum(i.get("quantity", 1) for i in state["items"] if i.get("template") == output)
                result = run(state, ctx, "manufacture", {"recipe": recipe["id"], "result": output})
                assert (
                    sum(
                        i.get("quantity", 1)
                        for i in result["state"]["items"]
                        if i.get("template") == output
                    )
                    > old
                )
                assert any(
                    d["properties"].get("game_template_id") == output
                    for d in result["catalog"]["definitions"]
                )

                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("id", list(catalog.load()), ids=list(catalog.load()))
    def test_each_catalog_element_has_a_real_execution_path(id):
        row = catalog.row(id)
        kind = row["kind"]
        class_id = (
            row["class_id"]
            if kind == "talent"
            else "artisan"
            if kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour")
            else "mage"
        )
        state, ctx = fixture_state(class_id)
        if kind in ("spell", "talent"):
            primary = row["effects"][0]["op"]
            target = "watcher" if primary in ("damage", "drain_mp", "revive") else "hero"
            if primary == "revive":
                for entity in ctx["catalog"]["entities"]:
                    if entity["id"] == target:
                        entity["state"]["hp"] = 0
            args = {"spell" if kind == "spell" else "talent": id, "target": target}
            if primary in ("repair", "appraise"):
                item = next(i for i in state["items"] if i["id"] == state["weapon"])
                item["durability"] = 1
                args["item"] = item["id"]
            if primary == "travel":
                args["destination"] = "path"
            result = run(state, ctx, "cast" if kind == "spell" else "ability", args)
            if row["mode"] in ("delayed", "sustained"):
                next_context = ctx | {k: result[k] for k in ("world", "catalog", "scene")}
                result = run(result["state"], next_context, "wait", {"minutes": 30})
                assert not result["state"]["pending"]
            assert result["state"]["mp"] >= 0 and result["state"]["st"] >= 0
        elif kind == "consumable":
            engine = Engine(state, ctx, DiceRoller(seed=0), {})
            item = engine.add_item(id)
            before_quantity = item["quantity"]
            if row["category"] == "ammunition":
                bow = engine.add_item("gear_longbow_0_0")
                engine.state["weapon"] = bow["id"]
                engine.state["items"] = [
                    i for i in engine.state["items"] if not i.get("ammunition") or i["id"] == item["id"]
                ]
                engine.state["battle"] = {
                    "order": ["hero", "watcher"],
                    "sides": {"hero": "party", "watcher": "enemy"},
                    "round": 1,
                }
                ready = engine.finish()
                args = {"target": "watcher"}
                command = "attack"
            else:
                ready = engine.finish()
                command = "consume"
                primary = row.get("effects", [])[0]["op"]
                args = {
                    "item": item["id"],
                    "target": "watcher"
                    if row["category"] == "scrolls" or primary == "revive"
                    else "hero",
                }

                    for entity in ready["catalog"]["entities"]:
                        if entity["id"] == "watcher":
                            entity["state"]["hp"] = 0

                command,
                args,
            )
            assert (
                sum(i["quantity"] for i in result["state"]["items"] if i["id"] == item["id"])
                == before_quantity - 1
            )
        elif kind in ("recipe", "material", "household", "weapon", "armour"):
